description: This file defines core data models and enums for a Ludo game, including player colors, piece positions, game state, and move representations.

classes.name: PiecePosition
classes.description: Immutable value object representing a piece's location in the game.

classes.name: LudoPlayer
classes.description: Represents a player in the game, including color and display name.

classes.name: LudoPieceId
classes.description: Identifies a specific game piece by color and number.

classes.name: GameState
classes.description: Represents the entire state of a game, including players, positions, current turn, dice, and game status.

classes.name: LudoMove
classes.description: Represents a move made by a player, specifying the piece and dice roll.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a modified copy of the GameState with specified changes.
